textLabel: Type your places, one line per step
textHint: Each line is one step. Write a country, or several separated by commas, and a note after a colon. Up to 40 steps.
syntax: Syntax guide: everything you can write
syntaxHint: Tap Add to put a line in your list.
empty: Write a first line above, for example: India
zoom: Fly the camera to each place
counter: Show a running count on the video
finale: Zoom out to show everything at the end
voiceHint: Record your voice while you tap through the steps, so each place lights up when you say it. Or add an audio file you already have. Your voice stays on your device.
voiceTapTitle: Recording: say it, then tap Next step
voiceReady: Tap Next step each time you move to the next place. The map shows the whole world until your first tap.
voiceBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow the microphone for this page, or add an audio file instead.
voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone. Add an audio file instead.
voiceReadFailed: That audio could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
voiceTimed: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps follow the moments you tapped.
voiceFitted: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The steps are spread to fit it.
voiceChanged: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. You changed the number of steps after recording, so the steps are spread to fit the voice.
voiceFit: Spread the steps to fit the voice
voiceNoSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video. The video will be made without it. You can add your voice in your editing app.
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot. If you added your voice here, the sound is already in the file.
credit: Country borders follow India's official map. Only big cities can be pinned by name; for any other place write its latitude and longitude.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
countriesHint: Search for a country, then tap Add to put it in your list.

syntaxItems.title: A country
syntaxItems.note: The country lights up, the map flies to it and a card shows its name. Add a note after a colon.

syntaxItems.title: Several countries in one step
syntaxItems.note: Separate names with commas. They light up together and the map fits all of them.

syntaxItems.title: A pin on a city
syntaxItems.note: For big cities. Add Country after the city name if two cities share a name.

syntaxItems.title: A pin on any point
syntaxItems.note: Write latitude, then longitude, then a name.

syntaxItems.title: Zoom out to the world
syntaxItems.note: Shows the whole world with everything lit so far. A note is optional.

syntaxItems.title: A pause
syntaxItems.note: Holds the picture for 2 seconds, or the number you write.

syntaxItems.title: A title
syntaxItems.note: Stays at the top of the video.

endCard: Show a card with the total at the end
counterText: Your words for the running count
endText: Your words for the end card
textOptionsHint: Write {n} where the number should go, for example: {n} countries visited. Leave a box empty for the standard words.
